mapper.select: select * from px_user_file where owner_id=#{owner} and id=#{id}
select * from px_user_file where owner_id=#{owner} and parent_id=#{parent} and del_flag=0 and id > #{after} order by id limit 100
select * from px_user_file where owner_id=#{owner} and is_folder=true and del_flag=0 order by id limit 1000
select coalesce(sum(byte_size),0) from px_user_file where owner_id=#{owner}
select count(*) from px_user_file where owner_id=#{owner} and parent_id=#{parent} and display_name=#{name} and del_flag=0 and id != #{exclude}
select count(*) from px_user_file where owner_id=#{owner} and parent_id=#{parent} and del_flag=0
mapper.update: update px_user_file set parent_id=#{parentId},display_name=#{displayName},del_flag=#{delFlag},revision=revision+1,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id=#{id} and owner_id=#{ownerId} and revision=#{revision}
